description:
MOEBEER is a UK streetwear label built on original art. Every design starts as the founder's own artwork, printed on organic and heavyweight cotton, made to order, and dispatched from the UK. No overproduction, no fast fashion. Wear your weird. Own your story.


What you earn

• 10% on every sale from your link or code

• 15% on a customer's first order

• 30-day cookie — you are credited if they buy within a month

• Sale confirmed 30 days after purchase if not returned, then paid in the next monthly payout (bank transfer or PayPal)

• Personal link, your own discount code, product images and a creator dashboard


What sells

Oversized high-neck tees (£32), sweatshirts (£38), hoodies (£48) in the Arabic calligraphy collection (Sabr, Salam, HUB, Peace, Love), plus £19.50 graphic tees. Free UK delivery; we also ship to the US, Canada, the EU and the UAE.


Who does well here

Style and lifestyle creators, art and design voices, slow-fashion advocates, community and newsletter builders. Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, blogs and newsletters all work. We care about point of view, not follower count.


House rules

Label gifted or commissioned posts clearly (#ad / #gifted — UK ASA rules). No bidding on the MOEBEER name in paid search. No posting codes on coupon or deal sites. No spam. Say what you actually think about the product.
payout_period: Monthly. A sale is confirmed 30 days after purchase if the order is not returned, then paid in the next monthly payout by bank transfer or PayPal.
term_and_condition:
MOEBEER Creator Programme - Terms and Conditions

1. Eligibility. You must be 18 or over and have an audience or platform you are entitled to post on. We review every application by hand and may decline or remove an account at our discretion.

2. Commission. You earn 10% of the order value (excluding shipping and discounts) on every order placed through your link or code, and 15% when it is the customer's first MOEBEER order. Orders you place for yourself, and orders that are refunded, cancelled or charged back, do not earn commission.

3. Tracking. Referrals are tracked by a 30-day cookie and by your discount code. If a customer's most recent referral came from another creator, that creator is credited.

4. Approval and payment. A sale is confirmed 30 days after purchase, once the customer's return window has closed and the order has not been returned. Confirmed commissions are paid monthly by bank transfer or PayPal to the details in your dashboard.

5. Promotion rules. Be honest about MOEBEER and only make claims we make ourselves. Do not bid on the MOEBEER name or our product names in paid search or Google Ads, do not post your code on coupon or cashback sites, and do not send unsolicited messages. Disclose the relationship (for example #ad) where the law requires it. You may use our product images and copy; you may not alter our artwork or logo or present yourself as MOEBEER.

6. Ending the relationship. Either of us can end it at any time. Confirmed commissions earned before that date are still paid; commissions from activity that breaks these terms are cancelled.

7. Data. We use your details to run the programme, track referrals and pay you, as described in our Privacy Policy. Questions: support@moebeer.com.
